title: Tailwise Autoship Credit on the Tailwise Plus Annual First Term — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
When a customer on a free tier of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** buys Tailwise Plus Annual, an Autoship credit — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the first-term Plus Annual fee according to the charged shipments that the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions carry dated in the last six months.

| Charged Tailwise Autoship shipments dated in the last six months | Autoship credit |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | $4.00 |
| 3 to 5 | $2.00 |
| fewer than 3 | none |

Shipments of every Tailwise Autoship subscription the customer holds are counted together.

**Edges (hypothetical counts).** 2 shipments: none. 3 shipments: $2.00. 5 shipments: $2.00. 6 shipments: $4.00.
